title: resourceRequest
responsibility: Resolves explicit or automatic CPU and memory requests against live headroom or an inherited parent reservation.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.flags
inputs.description: Resources CLI priority, CPU, RAM and label fields, including supported auto sizing.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.service
inputs.description: Queue access, current telemetry and configuration directory used to resolve automatic requests.

inputs.name: resourceRequest.env
inputs.description: Reads HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE to detect an inherited parent lease, then HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS and HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB as its budget for auto fields. Other entries are ignored.

outputs.name: resourceRequest
outputs.description: Validated concrete request preserving parent limits for nested automatic sizing.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown when the resolved priority, CPU, memory or label fails the request schema, including malformed or non-positive numbers.

examples.subject: resourceRequest
examples.name: Size an automatic worker from idle headroom
examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: 'auto', memoryMib: 'auto' }, service, {})

examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: 'auto', memoryMib: 'auto' }, service, {})

examples.name: Use the inherited parent budget for automatic sizing
examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: 'auto', memoryMib: 'auto' }, service, env)

examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: '3', memoryMib: '2048' }, service, env)

examples.subject: resourceRequest
examples.name: Keep a CPU reserve on a single-core quota
examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: 'auto', memoryMib: 'auto' }, service, {})

examples.name: Wait with one CPU when telemetry is unavailable
examples.call: await resourceRequest({ priority: 'agent-test', cpus: 'auto', memoryMib: 'auto' }, service, {})

examples.subject: resourceRequest
